subject: VM evidence workback & SOC2/SIG ask — Valence Financial
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@valence-fin.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@valence-fin.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidated VM evidence for SOC2/SIG review

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking this on. Valence's compliance team is kicking off their internal evidence intake for SOC2 and a vendor SIG review next week. They asked if we can provide a single packaged set that shows:
- scan cadence (tooling + schedule) for the last 12 months
- SLA for critical/high CVE remediation and an example incident showing timelines
- exported CVE remediation log (proof of patch + ticket links)
- a short statement confirming our process for third-party dependency CVEs

Can you confirm whether Redwood can deliver a compact packet by EOD Friday (9/5)? If that's tight, a two-day workback is acceptable but we need clear owners and artifacts.

Preferable delivery format: one zipped package + an index spreadsheet. If you can send a quick proposed workback with owners, I will route to Valence's audit queue.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Olivia
Olivia Park
Sr. Security Manager, Valence Financial
olivia.park@valence-fin.com
Attachment: valence_evidence_request_090325.pdf (PDF)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@valence-fin.com>
Cc: security@valence-fin.com, J. Thomas <jthomas@scanservices.io>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated VM evidence for SOC2/SIG review

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can put together the consolidated packet and I can commit to delivering a zip and index spreadsheet by EOD Friday (9/5). Below is a proposed workback with owners; please confirm if Valence needs additional artifact types (e.g., full scan exports vs. summary matrix).

Proposed Redwood workback (deliverable: Redwood_VM_Evidence_20250905.zip):
- Scan cadence matrix (last 12 months): sofia_ivanova (build + verify) — includes tool names, scan frequency, scope (hosts/container/image) and retention.
- CVE remediation log (exported): marissa_cole (pull from ticketing + attach proof artifacts) — will include ticket IDs and patch PRs where applicable.
- SLA statement + example timeline: neha_kapoor (author + attest) — include one anonymized example (critical CVE) showing time-to-detect, triage, patch, and verification.
- SIG/CAIQ index sheet mapping artifacts to question IDs: sofia_ivanova (compile).

Attachments we plan to include: scan_cadence_matrix_2025Q2.csv, cve_remediation_log_2025-08.pdf (redacted where needed), sig_evidence_index_2025.xlsx.

Open items for Valence:
1) Do you need raw scanner XML/JSON exports, or is the summarized CSV sufficient?
2) Any masking requirements for customer-identifying hostnames?
3) Please confirm that the anonymized example can reference Ticket ID VAL-REDACTED in place of live IDs — you mentioned audit team prefers traceability but not sensitive ops data.

We will start assembling today and I will send a progress update tomorrow morning. cc'd J. Thomas from ScanServices for quick export support if we need raw scan exports.

Regards,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Security Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Attachment: proposed_workback_090325.txt (text)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Valence evidence packet — task split + redaction guidance

Team — quick internal plan to meet the Friday EOD deliverable. Please reply inline with any blockers: 

Marissa — I need the CVE remediation log exported from our ticketing system (last 12 months) with the following columns: CVE, affected asset type, discovery date, patch PR/commit, ticket ID, remediation date, verification evidence link. Please produce PDF export with proof screenshots where available and a CSV extract for the index. Target: EOD Thu (9/4) so I can stitch.

Neha — draft a 2-paragraph SLA statement that we can sign off on. Include our standard SLA windows (Critical: 7 days, High: 30 days), plus the remediation exception handling (hotpatch, vendor dependency escalations). Also identify one anonymized example from August 2025 we can include showing the end-to-end timeline. Target: tomorrow morning (9/5 09:00).

Redaction guidance: remove internal agent usernames, replace hostnames with host-XXXXX, and replace any customer-specific identifiers with CUSTOMER-REDACTED. Keep ticket mapping in the index but replace the ticket ID column with a redacted key (e.g., VAL-REDACTED -> map key). We will preserve traceability by including the mapping manifest in a separate control file (manifest_map.txt).

I will assemble the index and compress the package. If Marissa needs raw scanner exports, loop in J. Thomas; otherwise a sanitized attachable PDF + CSV is fine.

Thanks,
Sofia
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@valence-fin.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@valence-fin.com
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VM evidence workback & SOC2/SIG ask — Valence Financial

Sofia —

This looks good, and thank you for the clear owners. Valence is fine with summarized CSVs + redacted PDFs; we do not need raw scanner XML unless there are gaps in the CSV. The anonymized example can use VAL-REDACTED mapping as recommended.

One request from the audit team: please include a short note in the index that clarifies how we classify severity (CVSS threshold + any business context overrides) — they want to see how you map scanner severities to our remediation SLA. If you add that as a single-sheet explanation in sig_evidence_index_2025.xlsx, we're all set.

I'll hold review until we get the zip. If you need more time, reply and we'll push the internal date.

Olivia
Sr. Security Manager, Valence Financial
Attachment: valence_audit_instructions_090525.pdf (PDF)
